### What feature or improvement do you have in mind?
A clear and concise description of what you'd love to see in ByteMap.

### What problem does this solve?
Why is this useful? How does it make inspecting or recovering disk space easier for you?

### How do you imagine it working?
Describe how it should look or feel (bonus points if you have UI ideas or sketches!).

### Any alternatives you've considered?
Have you tried other ways to do this, or seen similar features in other tools?

### Extra Context
Add any other screenshots, links, or notes here.
